summary: IP-Based Currency Detection feature testing complete. Backend: 18/18 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All 5 test scenarios passed - first visit detection, manual override, preference persistence, currency switching, and dropdown verification.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/currency/detect returns 200
Backend: GET /api/currency/detect has required fields (detected, currency, country_code, message)
Backend: GET /api/currency/detect has currency details when detected (currency_name, currency_symbol, country_name)
Backend: GET /api/currency/detect returns valid supported currency
Backend: GET /api/currency/detect returns IP address used for detection
Backend: GET /api/currency/country-mapping returns 200
Backend: GET /api/currency/country-mapping has required structure (mapping, supported_currencies)
Backend: GET /api/currency/country-mapping has 38+ country mappings
Backend: GET /api/currency/country-mapping has 12 supported currencies
Backend: African countries mapped correctly (NG→NGN, GH→GHS, KE→KES, ZA→ZAR, SN→XOF, CM→XAF)
Backend: European countries mapped correctly (GB→GBP, DE/FR/IT/ES→EUR)
Backend: Other major countries mapped (US→USD, CA→CAD, AU→AUD, IN→INR)
Backend: CFA zones mapped correctly - XOF (8 countries), XAF (6 countries)
Backend: X-Forwarded-For header handled correctly
Backend: Private IP addresses handled gracefully (returns null country)
Backend: Localhost (127.0.0.1) handled gracefully
Backend: All 12 currencies present in supported list
Backend: All currencies have at least one country mapping
Frontend: First visit detection - DETECTED_KEY set to 'true'
Frontend: Exchange rates cached in localStorage (afrovending_rates)
Frontend: Manual currency override (NGN) saved to localStorage
Frontend: Currency preference (NGN) persists after page reload
Frontend: Detection skipped for users with existing preference
Frontend: Currency switch from NGN to EUR works correctly
Frontend: All 12 currency options present in dropdown with data-testid
critical_code_review_comments: Good: IP detection uses ip-api.com (free, 45 req/min limit) with proper timeout (5s)
Good: Private IPs (127.0.0.1, 10.*, 192.168.*, 172.*) are excluded from detection
Good: X-Forwarded-For header parsing takes first IP in chain (original client)
Good: DETECTED_KEY prevents repeated detection attempts
Good: Toast notification with 'Change' action for easy manual override
Good: Frontend detection only runs when STORAGE_KEY is absent AND DETECTED_KEY is absent
Good: Currency options have proper data-testid attributes for automated testing
Good: CurrencySelector groups currencies by region (Major vs African)
seed_data_creation: No seed data needed - tested with existing products and live IP geolocation
context_for_next_testing_agent: IP-based currency detection fully working. Backend routes at /backend/routes/currency.py (lines 303-400). Frontend detection in CurrencyContext.js (detectCurrency function). Uses ip-api.com for geolocation. 38 countries mapped to 12 currencies. Detection happens once per user (tracked via localStorage DETECTED_KEY). Server IP shows US since hosted there. Toast notification shows when currency auto-set to non-USD value.
